name: quick-ai
title: Quick AI
description: Raycast-style quick AI answers from any OpenAI-compatible server
author: njpatel

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask AI
commands.subtitle: Quick AI
commands.description: Get a quick, streaming AI answer

commands.name: ask-selection
commands.title: Ask AI about Selection
commands.subtitle: Quick AI
commands.description: Ask about the currently selected text

commands.name: ask-clipboard
commands.title: Ask AI about Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Quick AI
commands.description: Ask about the current clipboard text

commands.name: model-list
commands.title: Select AI Model
commands.subtitle: Quick AI
commands.description: Pick the model Quick AI uses, listed live from the server

commands.name: ai-commands
commands.title: AI Commands
commands.subtitle: Quick AI
commands.description: Run reusable prompts on the selected text

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: API Base URL
preferences.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Leave empty to use codex-pooled (CLIProxyAPI from ~/codex-pooled/config.toml).

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Bearer token. Leave empty to use the codex-pooled token from ~/.bashrc.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Fallback Model
preferences.description: Used only when no model has been picked with Select AI Model. Leave empty to use the codex-pooled default.

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action on Answers
preferences.description: What Enter does on an answer (Raycast defaults to paste)

preferences.name: sidebarCount
preferences.title: Sidebar Conversations
preferences.description: How many recent conversations to show in the Quick AI sidebar

preferences.name: newChatMinutes
preferences.title: Continue Last Chat Within (minutes)
preferences.description: 0 (default) = every launch starts a new chat; pick recent ones from the sidebar. N = a launch within N minutes continues the last chat. "never" = always continue.

preferences.name: systemPrompt
preferences.title: System Prompt
preferences.default: You are a quick-answer assistant inside a launcher. Answer directly and concisely in Markdown. Lead with the answer itself; add brief detail only when it genuinely helps.
